name: Thigulla Meghraj Goud
title: Senior AI Developer & Full Stack Engineer

roles.title: Full Stack Engineer & Senior AI Developer

outcomes: Live on Google Play and App Store: IYOV AI Employee, Jobs, LMS, HRMS (Android + iOS); Medical Advisor and TFG SecureBanking on Google Play.
Prepared Android and iOS release builds and store submissions for 6 apps per platform, typically under one hour per platform, excluding store review.
Deployed 50-100 applications to AWS EC2 (new rollouts and production updates), typically under 30 minutes each.

Built the OCR and document-verification pipeline on PaddleOCR (ONNX Runtime), a 64-type document taxonomy and BGE-M3 embeddings; about 8 documents per minute, with an estimated 75% reduction in manual verification work.
Built the India statutory payroll engine (PF, ESI, TDS, professional tax) for IYOV AI, eliminating manual calculation steps for an internal eight-employee payroll workflow.
Mentored 8 engineers through codebase walkthroughs, architecture explanations and code reviews; acted as technical consultant to stakeholders, turning ambiguous requirements into delivery milestones.
Contributed to raising backend pytest coverage from 43% to 73.4%.
Maintained GitHub Actions workflows and Docker configurations for backend deployment, staging and canary releases.
